material.notes: ROUND 33 (still review, much closer): the diagonals are answered. Chromium's 20 px ring is a 16-gon (Skia cuts each 45 degree conic into 2^shift lines by SkEdge's distance rule; fitted on the reference, 16 sides with vertices on the circle give a residual 4 times below the true circle) and its partly covered pixels are lighter than exact area (a power of 1.2 on path coverage fits the rest); the Android profile now builds corners that way and fills a border as the area between two outlines. Ring px over 12 levels, unchecked: rest 62 before and 10 now, hover 15, focus 14, pressed 21, disabled 2 (max 37 levels, at the state layer's rim); checked hover, focus and pressed 16 each, disabled 5.
